_comment: SharkNet service catalog (Phase 7 research refresh). Data-driven blocking: a domain suffix-matches a keyword (DNS/TLS-SNI/HTTP-Host). Generic shared clouds (akamai/cloudfront/fastly/amazonaws/googleapis roots) are EXCLUDED to avoid collateral; where playback rides a shared CDN the block is best-effort (see notes + confidence). QUIC=true services lean on UDP/443 -> scoped IP pinning, no decryption. No live updates: this file is the static known-good baseline (see services_update.py).

services.name: YouTube
services.notes: googlevideo.com = playback; heavy QUIC (UDP/443) so scoped IP-drop needed. youtubei.googleapis.com is host-specific (not the shared googleapis root).

services.name: Netflix
services.notes: nflxvideo.net = Open Connect playback (TCP/TLS, no meaningful QUIC). All Netflix-owned.

services.name: Disney+
services.notes: dssott.com = BAMTech playback (also serves ESPN+/Hulu-live). Shared bamgrid.com omitted to avoid cross-service collateral; raw segments on shared CDN = best-effort.

services.name: Amazon Prime Video
services.notes: amazonvideo.com + aiv-cdn.net = video delivery; atv-ps.amazon.com host-specific (won't touch amazon.com retail). Some segments on shared CloudFront/Akamai = best-effort.

services.name: Apple TV+
services.notes: hls-svod.itunes.apple.com = HLS manifest (host-specific, not the shared itunes root). Segments can fail over to shared Apple/Akamai CDN = best-effort.

services.name: Crunchyroll
services.notes: crunchyrollcdn.com = video playback (vod-*.crunchyrollcdn.com). vrv.co removed (VRV shut down May 2024).

services.name: MUBI
services.notes: mubicdn.net = MUBI's own video CDN. Tight 2-domain set covers app + playback.

services.name: DAZN
services.notes: indazn.com carries API + DASH manifests. Also a private in-ISP CDN + CloudFront for segments = best-effort. All DAZN-owned.

services.name: Max (HBO Max)
services.notes: max.com = app/auth/API/manifest; discomax.com = WBD backend; h264.io = WBD media (SNI-blockable, but SHARED with Discovery+). Raw segments shared CDN = best-effort. QUIC-capable CDNs.

services.name: Hulu
services.notes: hulu.com=app/auth/API, hulustream.com=streaming, huluim.com=assets. Playback edge on shared Disney bamgrid.com = best-effort for raw video, but login/browse/manifest block is decisive.

services.name: Peacock
services.notes: All operational endpoints (ovp/play/id/ssai) live under peacocktv.com. Segments on shared Akamai/Fastly = best-effort; manifest-host block breaks playback.

services.name: Paramount+
services.notes: paramountplus.com=app/auth, cbsivideo.com/cbsaavideo.com=video backend, pplusstatic.com=static. Shared cbsi.com/paramount.tech rejected. Ads/DRM shared = best-effort.

services.name: ESPN+
services.notes: Entitlement/playback run on shared Disney bamgrid.com/dssott.com (can't block without breaking Disney+/Hulu) = best-effort for video. Blocking espn.com makes the app unusable (also blocks free ESPN scores — usually intended).

services.name: Tubi
services.notes: adrise.tv = Tubi's dedicated backend (API/manifest/DRM license). Raw segments on shared Akamai/CloudFront = best-effort. Fox-owned, ad-supported.

services.name: Pluto TV
services.notes: All live endpoints (api/stitcher/images/players) under pluto.tv. Ad-stitched/VOD segments on shared CDN = best-effort. Paramount-owned.

services.name: BBC iPlayer
services.notes: iPlayer API/auth/player under bbc.co.uk + bbci.co.uk; blocking stops playlist/entitlement. Segments on shared CDN = best-effort. Over-blocks all BBC (acceptable, real domain). UK geo-locked.

services.name: ITVX
services.notes: itv.com = ITVX playlist/auth/API; itvstatic.com = ITV static assets. Media multi-CDN (Fastly/MainStreaming/Akamai) = best-effort. Over-blocks all ITV web. UK-only.

services.name: Channel 4
services.notes: channel4.com = API/ads; c4assets.com = Channel 4's dedicated media CDN incl. DASH manifests (Host stays *.c4assets.com even Akamai-fronted). UK-only.

services.name: NOW
services.notes: nowtv.com = NOW OTT API/auth. now.com REMOVED (that is PCCW Hong Kong 'NOW', a different service). Broad sky.com excluded. Media on shared Akamai/CloudFront = best-effort. UK/IE.

services.name: Canal+
services.notes: Fully service-dedicated: canalplus.com=API, mycanal.fr=player, canal-plus.com=media hub, canalplus-cdn.net=Canal+'s OWN CDN (live+VOD). France.

services.name: RTL+
services.notes: rtlplus.de = web/login; tvnow.de = the RTL+ OTT player-BFF/manifest backbone (app is de.rtli.tvnow). Broad rtl.de + the linear RTLup rtl-plus.de excluded. DACH+LU.

services.name: Movistar+
services.notes: movistarplus.es = frontend/player/account; blocking breaks auth + player init. Media/DRM ride shared Telefonica platform (not safe to base-block) = best-effort. Spain.

services.name: Viaplay
services.notes: viaplay.com = central entitlement/login API (all country frontends call it); viaplay.tv = CDN/subs/infra. Media CloudFront + NPAW multi-CDN = best-effort. Nordics + NL.

services.name: SkyShowtime
services.notes: Single-domain kill: clients/auth/API/media-CDN all under *.skyshowtime.com even where CDN-fronted. Peacock/Sky tech, ~20+ EU markets.

services.name: Molotov
services.notes: molotov.tv = whole service (fapi front-API/app/images/account). DASH segment CDN third-party = best-effort, but fapi block is decisive. Do NOT confuse with the molotovtv.com clone. France.

services.name: Shahid
services.notes: MBC Shahid: shahid.net = app/API/media hosts; shahid.mbc.net host-specific (not bare mbc.net). Segments on shared CDN = best-effort.

services.name: WATCH IT
services.notes: watchit.com covers app (com.watchit.vod)/API/site. Video via Brightcove (shared) = best-effort. Egyptian (United Media Services).

services.name: TOD
services.notes: tod.tv = app (com.todtv.tod)/API/site. beIN-group MENA OTT; live+VOD segments on shared CDN = best-effort. Separate from the bein entry.

services.name: OSN+
services.notes: OSN-owned: go.osn.com (live app) + api.osnplus.com caught by SNI suffix regardless of Fastly/Incapsula front. Playback shared = best-effort. ex-Wavo.

services.name: Yango Play
services.notes: SCOPED: play.yango.com (won't touch the yango.com taxi/delivery super-app) + apex yangoplay.com. Yandex infra, HTTP/3-heavy = scoped UDP/443 drop needed.

services.name: Viu
services.notes: viuapi.io = API; three Viu-owned domains. Media multi-CDN (Akamai/CloudFront/Tencent/BytePlus) = best-effort for playback.

services.name: STARZPLAY
services.notes: starzplay.com suffix covers arabia.starzplay.com + API + app (com.parsifal.starz). ALSO now hosts the ADMN/ADtv section (ADtv app retired Nov 2025). Segments on CloudFront = best-effort.

services.name: beIN Sports/Connect
services.notes: beinsports.com (news/app), bein.net (connect.bein.net = beIN CONNECT), beinconnect.com (legacy MENA/still-live TR). Live video on shared CDN = best-effort. TOD is the newer MENA OTT.

services.name: Weyyak
services.notes: Current apex weyyak.com (api.weyyak.com caught by suffix). Runs on Zee/Z5 backend but z5.com/zee5.com excluded (over-blocks ZEE5). Media shared CDN = best-effort.

services.name: Rotana
services.notes: rotana.net (app net.rotana) covers live TV + VOD + subdomains. Rotana Media (Saudi). Segment CDN shared = best-effort.

services.name: Jawwy TV (STC)
services.notes: jawwy.tv = Intigral/STC OTT (distinct from stc tv and the jawwy.sa telecom portal). Playback via shared CDN = best-effort.

services.name: Spotify
services.notes: spotify.com=app/API, scdn.co/spotifycdn.com/spotifycdn.net=images/config CDN, pscdn.co=podcast CDN. Music audio rides shared Fastly/Akamai (audio-cf/ak) = best-effort for playback; browse/login/API fully blocked.

services.name: Anghami
services.notes: Self-contained: anghami.com=app/API, anghcdn.co=artwork/audio/video CDN. All app+media resolve under these two. MENA-focused.

services.name: SoundCloud
services.notes: soundcloud.com=app/api-v2, sndcdn.com=HLS audio + artwork CDN. Two domains fully cover app + playback (name-blockable via SNI even though CDN-fronted).

services.name: Apple Music
services.notes: music.apple.com = web player + amp-api. Blocks web player/catalog/API. Native-app audio rides shared itunes.apple.com/mzstatic (deliberately NOT blocked) = best-effort for native playback.

services.name: TikTok
services.notes: tiktok.com=core, tiktokv.com=API, tiktokcdn*.com=video CDN (+ regional -us/-eu), byteoversea.com/ibytedtos.com=ByteDance backend. HEAVY QUIC on ByteDance's own edge -> scoped UDP/443 drop ESSENTIAL.

services.name: Instagram
services.notes: instagram.com=app/graph API, cdninstagram.com=IG media. Remaining media on shared Meta fbcdn.net (under facebook) = best-effort. HEAVY QUIC (Meta mvfst) -> scoped UDP/443 drop.

services.name: Facebook
services.notes: facebook.com=core, fbcdn.net=Meta media CDN (SHARED across FB/IG/WA media by design), fbsbx.com=attachments, fb.com=redirect, facebook.net=SDK/pixel/Login. HEAVY QUIC (mvfst).

services.name: Snapchat
services.notes: snapchat.com=core, sc-cdn.net=Snap media CDN, snap.com=corporate/ads, snapkit.com=Snap Kit/Login SDK. HEAVY QUIC (Cronet); much media on shared Google Cloud IPs so IP-drop stays tightly scoped = best-effort.

services.name: WhatsApp
services.notes: whatsapp.com=registration/web/API, whatsapp.net=chat edge + media (g/mmg/scontent.whatsapp.net). Core chat = long-lived TLS/TCP so the name block stops messaging. Calls use non-443 UDP (RTP) = outside 443/QUIC scope.

services.name: Twitter/X
services.notes: x.com=current app/API, twitter.com=legacy/redirect, twimg.com=image/video CDN (Fastly-hosted but the twimg.com NAME is blockable), t.co=link wrapper. DNS+SNI name block suffices.

services.name: PUBG/Games
services.notes: pubgmobile.com/igamecj.com/proximabeta.com = PUBG Mobile (Tencent/Proxima), pubg.com = PUBG PC/console (Krafton). steampowered.com/epicgames.com = broad Steam/Epic launcher domains (block the ENTIRE platform) - deliberate mixed bucket. Live gameplay is non-443 UDP = outside 443/QUIC scope.
